provenance: Original authored CML layouts, 2026-10-22, recipe packet() in scripts/validation/check_cml_coordinate_precision.py; no third-party or sealed corpus.
minimization: Two distinct atoms C/O and one single bond; preserves unambiguous correspondence with no symmetry or stereo. Numeric representation boundary values are separate unit tests, not physically meaningful geometries.

oracle.name: Python ElementTree and authored finite binary64 values; Rust parse_cml and parse_cml_strict unit checks are bitwise
oracle.comparison: absolute tolerance 1e-10 angstrom, no relative tolerance, no alignment; exact equality diagnostic separate

expected.all_cases: Two neutral non-isotopic atoms C/O with one single bond; supplied 2D positions within absolute tolerance 1e-10
expected.unit_tests: Finite binary64 values including signed zero, smallest subnormal, normal boundary, maximum magnitude and floats adjacent to one retain all bits after both readers; no scientific geometry claim.
